## What a person is trying to hold on to

Describe it as part of a life, not as a database field.

## Who does the work

- [ ] The AI does it, and the person only visits
- [ ] The person has to enter, tidy or review something

**If the second box is ticked, this is very unlikely to be accepted.** The product exists to remove that cost, and a capability that reintroduces it makes the whole system worse.

## Does it need a guilt mechanic to work?

Counts, badges, streaks, scores, progress rings and red are absent by design — from the schema and the component library, not just the style guide. If the idea depends on one of them, describe what it looks like without.

## Which area it belongs to

Memories · People · Money · Body · Papers · Decisions · Someday · Tasks · Projects · Goals · Habits · Areas — or explain why it needs a new one.

## Privacy impact

What would an agent need to read for this to work, and would that be reasonable to grant?
